title: Holy Trinity Church being built 1917 c. by Hartland Cement Company
description: The Holy Trinity Anglican Church stands prominently at the corner of Orser and High Street. For four years, Rev. Franchetti conducted services in public halls until, on June 18, 1917, the church acquired land. As a talented architect, he designed the striking Gothic-Norman-style cement-block building, using materials supplied by the Hartland Cement Company.
